description: x402 buyer runtime with Guardian gate for Trinity Guardian (ETHGlobal Tokyo 2026). Ports the verified POC agent.ts to the real build: quote decode from Payment-Required header (v2 format), Guardian check before sign, real EIP-3009 signing via @x402/evm ExactEvmScheme, spend accumulator with daily reset, and typed event emission for the UI dashboard. SRS: FR-1..FR-6, FR-15/FR-16, FR-50 (events), FR-60..FR-63 (demo runner).

userStories.title: createAgent factory with x402 client setup
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a createAgent(name, privateKey) factory that sets up the x402 client with ExactEvmScheme and spendControls so the agent can pay on Base Sepolia.
acceptanceCriteria: src/agent/index.ts exports createAgent(name: string, privateKey: `0x${string}`): Agent
x402Client.fromConfig with schemes: [{ network: 'eip155:84532', client: new ExactEvmScheme(signer) }]
spendControls.maxAmountPerPayment set to '$50' (SDK ceiling = dailyCap)
Agent interface: name, address, buy(resource, opts?), getSpendState(), onPaymentEvent(handler)
EVM_PRIVATE_KEY required — throws with clear message if missing
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: FR-1, FR-5, FR-6. Port from POC agent.ts. viem privateKeyToAccount for signer.

userStories.title: Quote decoder for x402 v2 format
userStories.description: As an agent, I want to decode the Payment-Required header (base64 JSON, v2 format) so I can extract payTo, amount, asset, network for Guardian screening.
acceptanceCriteria: src/agent/quote.ts exports decodeQuote(header) and pickAccept(quote)
Handles v2 format: { x402Version, error, resource: { url, description, mimeType }, accepts: PaymentRequirements[] }
pickAccept prefers eip155:84532, falls back to any eip155:, then accepts[0]
Does not crash on missing optional fields (description, mimeType, extra)
Types match src/agent/types.ts (PaymentRequirements, X402Quote)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: FR-2, FR-3. POC agent.ts pickAccept() is the reference implementation.

userStories.title: buy() orchestration with Guardian gate
userStories.description: As an agent, I want buy(resource) to: plain fetch → decode 402 quote → call Guardian.checkPolicy() → sign via fetchWithPayment only if approved, so no payment ever bypasses the Guardian.
acceptanceCriteria: src/agent/buy.ts implements: fetch → 402 → decode → guardian.checkPolicy(reqs, dailySpend) → sign or refuse
hard_fail → returns { status: 'refused', reason } without signing
soft_fail → calls guardian.requestApproval(reqs, reasons); denied → refused
On success: signs with wrapFetchWithPayment, reads payment-response header, returns { status: 'paid', txHash }
Spend accumulator incremented only after successful settlement
Sign/settle errors caught and returned as refused with reason (no unhandled rejections)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: FR-4. Uses mock guardian until task-guardian lands: amount > 5M → soft_fail, scam addr → hard_fail, else pass.

userStories.title: Spend accumulator with daily reset
userStories.description: As a guardian, I want the agent to track daily spend (UTC window) so cap checks use a running total.
acceptanceCriteria: SpendState { spendToday: bigint, txCount, window: ISO-date, lastUpdated }
getSpendState() returns current accumulator
Resets when window !== today (UTC ISO date)
Increments by amount (atomic units) after each successful payment
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: FR-15, FR-16. Storage is in-memory for MVP (on-chain accumulator is out of scope per SRS).

userStories.title: Payment event emission for UI
userStories.description: As a UI dashboard, I want to subscribe to payment lifecycle events so I can render the live 3-layer journey.
acceptanceCriteria: Event types: quote_received, guardian_checking, guardian_verdict, approval_requested, approval_response, signing, paid, refused
PaymentEvent includes: type, timestamp, agentName, resource, payTo?, amount?, verdict?, txHash?, reason?
onPaymentEvent(handler) returns unsubscribe function
Events emitted at each lifecycle step during buy()
UI mock can console.log all events via subscription (verified in demo)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: FR-50 (UI dependency). Contract-first: event types are the UI task's primary dependency on this task.

userStories.title: CLI demo runner for 4 demo acts
userStories.description: As a presenter, I want a CLI runner that executes the 4 demo scenarios (pass, block, soft-fail, kill switch) so the demo works without the UI.
acceptanceCriteria: src/cli/demo.ts runs scenarios 1-4: /weather (pass), /data (block), /compute (soft-fail approval), revoked-role agent (kill switch)
Scenario 3 prompts approve/deny when TTY, auto-deny when not
Summary table at end: status per scenario + spend today
Exit code 0
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: FR-60..FR-63. Port from POC demo.ts. Scenario 4 depends on guardian ENS layer landing.
